caption: The drawing depicts a vibrant scene on a piece of worn, beige fabric with frayed edges. Central to the composition is a large bird, primarily blue with red, yellow, and green plumage, perched on a brown tree that bears a red and green flower. To the left of the bird and beneath the tree, there is a small yellow animal standing on a green, hilly terrain with pink and red flowers scattered throughout the foliage. To the right, another small tree with red-pink flowers hosts two smaller birds colored green and blue. In the background, there are additional stylized trees and foliage in shades of green, yellow, and blue. The upper border features partial floral designs in blue, pink, and green, while the main background remains a neutral fabric color. The overall composition includes a mix of large birds, flowers, small animals, and decorative greenery with varied bright colors and detailed embroidery.
title: Crewel Embroidered Chair Seat
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
